title: What Fueled the PlayStation’s 100‑Million‑Unit Surge?

scenes.text: The original PlayStation sold over 100 million units worldwide.
Its 33.9 mm CD‑ROM could hold up to 650 MB, far more than cartridge limits.
Sony bundled a dual‑shock controller with vibration, a first for home consoles.
CDs + vibration = the PlayStation’s secret weapon.
scenes.label: CD + VIBRATION
scenes.sub: Why gamers fell in love instantly

scenes.text: Follow for daily tech you should actually know.
